notes: Personal relief limits versioned per YA. Resident/non-resident citizen condition enforced in engine (resident_status=resident).

rules.condition: resident individual or non-resident citizen of Sri Lanka
rules.source_quote: Personal relief for a resident individual for YA 2024/25: one million two hundred thousand rupees per year of assessment (First Schedule / IRD Tax Chart 2024/25).

rules.condition: resident individual or non-resident citizen of Sri Lanka
rules.source_quote: Personal relief for a resident individual commencing YA 2025/26 has been increased to one million eight hundred thousand rupees (Act No. 02 of 2025 / IRD PN IT/2025-01).
